verses.text: I will lift up my eyes to the hills. Where does my help come from?
lines: I will lift up my eyes to the hills.
Where does my help come from?

verses.text: My help comes from Yahweh, who made heaven and earth.
He will not allow your foot to be moved. He who keeps you will not slumber.
lines: He will not allow your foot to be moved.
He who keeps you will not slumber.

verses.text: Behold, he who keeps Israel will neither slumber nor sleep.
Yahweh is your keeper. Yahweh is your shade on your right hand.
lines: Yahweh is your shade on your right hand.

verses.text: The sun will not harm you by day, nor the moon by night.
lines: The sun will not harm you by day,

verses.text: Yahweh will keep you from all evil. He will keep your soul.
lines: Yahweh will keep you from all evil.

verses.text: Yahweh will keep your going out and your coming in, from this time forward, and forever more.
lines: Yahweh will keep your going out and your coming in,
from this time forward, and forever more.
